entities.summary: The Nepali Army, also referred to as the Gorkhali Army, formerly known as the Royal Nepal Army) is the land warfare branch of the Nepalese Armed Forces. After the Gorkha Kingdom was founded in 1559, its army was established in 1560, and initially became known as the Gorkhali Army.
